note: Rule 170 of the Drugs Rules, 1945 (prior approval of the State Licensing Authority for advertisements of Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani drugs) was omitted by a July 2024 notification. A stay on that omission was vacated by the Supreme Court on 11 Aug 2025, so the omission stands and Rule 170 no longer imposes a prior-approval requirement. Older text of the Rules that still shows Rule 170 is outdated on this point.
